assessmentBufferPct.sourceTitle: Community First Bank Combined Credit Policy (Credit Underwriting Guidelines), April 2026 v1.0 — s2.6 Servicing
assessmentBufferPct.note: "An applications assessment rate will be the higher of the following: Housing Loans — Floor Rate 7.25%; Actual Rate + a 3% buffer".

rentShadingPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.3 Acceptable Income Verification
rentShadingPct.note: Rental income (long term, Australia only) assessed at 80%. Short-term rental also 80% where the property has been rented for a minimum of 12 months.

creditCardAssessmentPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.6 Servicing, Assessment Rates
creditCardAssessmentPct.note: Non-Community First Bank credit limits assessed at 3.75% per month of limit; Community First Bank's own credit limits at 3.2% per month.

bnplTreatment.value: Buy Now Pay Later facility limit is assessed at a repayment of 10% per month of the facility limit. The facility limit is calculated as the balance outstanding plus available credit from the applicant's statement.
bnplTreatment.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.6 Servicing, BNPL facilities

hemBasis.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.5 Living Expenses
hemBasis.note: "In all applications the higher of the Declared Living Expenses or Community First Bank Household Expenditure Model (HEM) is to be used".

hemLoadingPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.5 Living Expenses
hemLoadingPct.note: "Community First Bank will include a 5% buffer to all HEM living expense model calculations".

dtiCap.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s2.6 Servicing, DTI
dtiCap.note: Two-tier cap: "All applications where the prevailing LVR is >70%, 6 times is the maximum DTI. All applications where the prevailing LVR is <70%, 8 times is the maximum DTI." The conservative (>70% LVR) figure is recorded here.

notes.value: Minimum net surplus (ARA) of $1 per month is required for all applications; where ARA is under $200 and declared living expenses exceed HEM by less than $500, bank statements must be reviewed. An Investment Property Buffer of $600 per month is added to HEM for each investment property (not dwelling) held. Personal loans: fixed rate assessed at actual rate, variable at actual rate + 3% buffer.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s1.4 LVR Guidelines
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Maximum base LVR table tops out at 95% LVR, subject to a $1.5m property limit in capital city locations and $750,000 in regional locations. 95% is outside policy in 'other' (population under 15,000) locations.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s4.1 Variations, Partial Discharge
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: Not stated as a headline rule; inferred from the explicit statement "LMI to be obtained if new LVR is >80%" and from the 80% band in the LVR guideline table. Family Pledge / Family Guarantee is the published route to avoid LMI above 80%.

maxLvrCashOutPct.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s1.4 LVR Guidelines
maxLvrCashOutPct.note: "Cash Out loans — 80%". Third-party broker guide separately states "Equity Release (cash-out) up to 80% LVR where purpose is acceptable to CFB".

notes.value: Maximum allowable LVR matrix is location-banded. Capital city locations: 70% LVR up to a $10m property limit, 80% LVR up to $5m, 95% LVR up to $1.5m. Regional locations (population 15,000+): 70% up to $3m, 80% up to $1.5m, 95% up to $750,000. Other locations (population under 15,000): outside policy at 80% and 95%, refer to Credit Services. Where a facility is secured by multiple security properties the maximum facility LVR is 80%. More than 2 dwellings on a single title: 80%. Bridging loans: 80%. Home Guarantee Scheme: scheme maximum LVRs apply. High density dwellings: LMI guidelines apply. Valuation type also caps LVR: AVM 80%, desktop 80%, Valuer General notice 80% of unimproved capital value, short-form valuation up to 98% subject to lending policy.
notes.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s1.4 LVR Guidelines and s3.1 Acceptable Valuations

gamblingPolicy.value: Bank statement review: large cash withdrawals at licensed premises or transfers to betting applications must be explained, as must dishonours or rejected direct debits, unarranged overdrawn/over-limit conduct, credit card late payments or over-limit, and 75% or more of income being withdrawn in cash. Income sourced from gambling or wagering is unacceptable income.

notes.value: Bankruptcy is a hard knock-out: "Bankruptcy (regardless of status)" is an unacceptable credit finding, and unacceptable borrowers include anyone with a declared discharged bankruptcy evidenced on a current credit report or who is currently an undischarged bankrupt. All credit enquiries in the past 12 months must be commented on in the submission notes.

notes.value: Valuations must be less than 90 days old at assessment and less than 6 months old at settlement, and remain valid for 12 months for future borrowings. A short-form valuation is mandatory where LVR exceeds 80%, for off-the-plan and favourable purchases, high density dwellings, extended settlement cycles and construction loans. Construction is limited to a maximum of 4 self-contained residential dwellings under a licensed builder's HIA fixed-price contract, starting within 6 months of approval; owner-builder, kit/relocatable, cost-to-complete and split-contract construction are all excluded.

giftedDepositConditions.value: Written confirmation from the party making the gift that the amount is for the express purpose of purchasing the security property and is not repayable; the provider of the gift must be related to at least one of the borrowers; gifted funds must be available before any loan funds are accessed (e.g. construction loans). guarantorAccepted.sourceTitle: Combined Credit Policy April 2026 v1.0 — s1.5 Family Pledges

guarantorConditions.value: Family Pledge available from parents, grandparents, siblings, de facto partner or child. Guarantor must be at least 21. Purpose limited to purchase or construction of owner-occupied dwellings including off the plan — debt consolidation and equity release are unacceptable. Loan not to exceed 100% of the purchase price. Maximum guarantee limited to an amount not exceeding 20% of the purchase price. Fixed or variable P&I only (1 year interest-only allowed for construction). Guarantee limited to the minimum needed to eliminate LMI. Independent legal advice mandatory, 72-hour cooling off before settlement, and an exit strategy required where the guarantor offers their owner-occupied home. Second mortgage over the guarantor's security is acceptable. Term deposits held with Community First may also be taken as security up to 100% of value.

exitStrategyRequiredOverAge.note: Required for housing loan applications where the oldest applicant has had their 50th birthday at the date of application, where the loan is secured by the owner-occupied home, or is for an investment property that will be the applicant's only residential property. Acceptable strategies: downsizing, sale of an investment property, realisation of investments, or superannuation (supporting strategy only, with amortisation to retirement age).

notes.value: "Community First does not apply a maximum age for borrowers for any loan product or purpose" — an exit strategy is used instead from age 50. Unacceptable loan purposes include business/commercial purchases and developments, paying outstanding tax or statutory liabilities, refinancing debt-recovery/collections liabilities, second mortgages (other than guarantor second mortgages), refinancing partially complete dwellings, reverse mortgages, cash out above ALCO-approved limits, and construction or LVR over 80% using Easy Street loan products.
